dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: Compared to my hometown, the bustling life here suits me better.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: My hometown is Sumeru City. My family is still there. I moved to Port Ormos to look after the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: The people back in Sumeru, especially the Akademiya researchers, all walked at a pace way too leisurely for me!

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: Life here is busy, fulfilling, and more profitable — much better than back home.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: Even the hot curry I get after work tastes better.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: See you. May you lead a fulfilling life.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: Yeah. Curry is one thing that everyone in Sumeru knows how to cook.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: Its flavor varies from family to family because every family has their own curry recipe.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: But most of their curry tastes great.

dialogues.speaker: Ariana
dialogues.text: So, would you like to have a taste of my recipe?
